reviews.title: Great PSU
reviews.comment: I made the switch to corsair psu’s in 2020 after a evga short circuited out of the box and fried a lot of the components in my brand new build…this is now my 6th corsair psu (7th on the way) and I have never had a issue with any of them since 2020. They’re a little pricey but worth it having the ease of mind not worrying if my computer is going to turn into a fireworks show again.
